settings.question: Is shipping complimentary?
settings.answer: Yes. Standard shipping is complimentary on every KROZO order. Delivery options and estimates are shown at checkout.

settings.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.answer: Timing depends on the destination and product. The most relevant estimate is shown during checkout and in your order confirmation.

settings.question: Can I return an item?
settings.answer: You may request a return within 30 days of delivery, subject to our returns policy. Contact support with your order number for help.

settings.question: How do I choose the right product or size?
settings.answer: Check the dimensions and guidance on the product page. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering and tell us about your pet.

settings.question: Is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Yes. Available payment methods are displayed at checkout and payments are encrypted and processed through Shopify-powered checkout.

settings.question: How do product reviews work?
settings.answer: Customers can submit honest reviews after purchase. Reviews may be moderated for spam, privacy and relevance, but genuine critical feedback is not removed simply because it is negative.
